---
title: "tidying"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)

diving <- read_csv("continentalDiving.csv")

diving <- diving |> filter(!Discipline %in% c("NLT", "VWT"))

diving <- diving |> mutate(help_date = dmy(Date))

diving <- diving |> group_by(Discipline, Continent, Sex) |> arrange(help_date) |> slice(1)

real_diving <- diving |> select(Name, Sex, Discipline, Result, Announced, Date, Event, Continent)

write_csv(real_diving, "freedivingRecords.csv")
```
